gloss: leaving things to others; relying on others

definitions.gloss: leaving things to others; relying on others
definitions.explanation: Leaving to other people something one should do or decide oneself. It carries criticism, like its commoner variant {人任|ひとまか}せ.

examples.japanese: {他人任|たにんまか}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧な。
examples.english: Don't leave it to other people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ことな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、{他人任|たにんまか}せにして⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{後悔|こうかい}→後悔：02738_koukai⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: It's your own future; if you leave it to other people, you'll regret it.

notes:
Made of ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ (other people) + ⟦{任|まか}せ→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧ (leaving to, from ⟦{任|まか}せる→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧). It means the same as ⟦{人任|ひとまか}せ→人任せ：32448_hitomakase⟧, which is the commoner form; ⟦{他人|たにん}→他人：01459_tanin⟧ stresses that the others are not oneself.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {他人任|たにんまか}せ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to leave (something) to others
- {他人任|たにんまか}せな⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: an attitude of leaving everything to others

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{運任|うんまか}せ→運任せ：16269_unmakase⟧: leaving things to luck
- ⟦{成|な}り{行|ゆ}き→成り行き：07311_nariyuki⟧⟦{任|まか}せ→任せる：02417_makaseru⟧: letting things take their course
